meta.title: wowMD - A better way to read long Markdown
meta.description: wowMD is a lightweight Chrome extension that turns long GitHub READMEs and Markdown pages into structured, focused reading views.
language.label: Language
hero.label: Chrome extension
hero.title: Long Markdown, made readable.
hero.subtitle: wowMD adds an outline, collapsible sections, and a calmer reader to long GitHub READMEs and Markdown files. It appears only when the page is complex enough to help.
hero.upgradeTitle: Need local files, notes, or clean HTML?
hero.upgradeBody: wowMD Pro adds local Markdown processing, highlights, notes, and clean HTML export.
app.label: Paid upgrade
app.title: Need local files, notes, or clean HTML? Open wowMD Pro.
app.subtitle: The free extension improves GitHub reading. The paid webapp is for local Markdown workflows: read, highlight, annotate, and export without uploading your documents.
app.localBody: Open downloaded `.md` files in a focused browser workspace.
app.notesBody: Mark useful passages and keep local notes attached to the document.
app.htmlBody: Create complete, structured, offline-readable HTML for sharing or archiving.
demo.label: Demo
demo.title: See a long README become a focused reader.
demo.placeholderBody: Replace this frame when the new wowMD demo video is ready. Show Better View, outline navigation, the full-screen reader, section folding, code, and tables.
features.label: Features
features.title: Everything here has one job: better reading.
features.outlineBody: See the document structure before jumping into the full text.
features.foldingBody: Collapse large H2 sections independently when a document gets long.
features.codeBody: Keep code blocks readable with clean spacing and highlighting.
features.tableBody: Wide tables scroll sideways instead of breaking the reader layout.
features.smartBody: Stays out of the way on short READMEs and simple pages.
features.cleanBody: Fixes common relative image paths and safely sanitizes rendered Markdown.
scope.label: Scope
scope.title: Focused on GitHub Markdown, clear about the rest.
scope.notSupportedThree: Issues, pull requests, or wiki pages
scope.notSupportedFour: AI summaries, translation, or cloud sync
privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.title: A reader should not need your data.
privacy.two: No document uploads to third-party services.
privacy.three: No AI summaries, cloud analysis, or remote configuration.
privacy.four: No access to browsing history, cookies, account information, or local files.
privacy.five: No Raw Markdown or GitHub API request until you click Better View.
pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.title: Free during beta.
pricing.cardBody: wowMD is free during beta. While the reading experience improves, the core local reader remains usable without an account.
privacyPage.metaDescription: Privacy Policy for wowMD, a local-first Chrome extension for reading public GitHub Markdown pages.
privacyPage.label: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: wowMD is designed as a local-first Chrome extension for reading public GitHub Markdown pages.
privacyPage.summaryBody: wowMD does not collect personal information, upload documents, sell data, or track browsing history.
privacyPage.controllerBody: For privacy questions about wowMD, contact the maintainer through the feedback form linked on this website.
privacyPage.dataBody: The extension reads page content locally in your browser only when you choose Better View. It does not collect account data, cookies, browsing history, local files, or private repository content.
privacyPage.purposeBody: Processing is limited to providing the reading features you request, such as outline navigation, section folding, code rendering, and table layout. Where GDPR applies, this is based on providing the service you request and legitimate interest in operating a privacy-preserving browser tool.
privacyPage.storageBody: wowMD does not maintain a remote database for your reading activity. Any temporary processing happens in the browser session and is not sent to a wowMD server.
privacyPage.sharingBody: wowMD does not sell or share reading data. If you submit feedback through the website, the information you choose to provide, such as your message, feature preferences, and optional email address, is used only to read feedback and follow up on requested features.
privacyPage.googleTitle: Chrome Web Store and Limited Use
privacyPage.googleBody: wowMD uses browser permissions only to provide the disclosed reading features. Information received from Google APIs, if any, will be used in accordance with the Chrome Web Store User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.
privacyPage.rightsBody: Depending on your location, including the European Economic Area, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict, object to, or port personal data. Because wowMD does not store reading data on a server, most requests can be answered by explaining what is and is not collected.
privacyPage.childrenBody: wowMD is not directed to children and does not knowingly collect personal information from children.
privacyPage.changesBody: If wowMD changes its data practices, this policy will be updated before those changes are released.

termsPage.metaDescription: Terms and Conditions for the wowMD website, Chrome extension, and wowMD Pro webapp.
termsPage.label: Terms and Conditions
termsPage.title: Terms and Conditions
termsPage.intro: These terms explain how you may use the wowMD website, Chrome extension, and wowMD Pro webapp.
termsPage.summaryBody: Use wowMD responsibly, keep your own documents and license key safe, and do not misuse the service. The free extension and paid webapp are provided as focused Markdown reading tools.
termsPage.acceptanceBody: By using the wowMD website, extension, or webapp, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use wowMD.
termsPage.productsBody: wowMD currently includes a free Chrome extension for supported public GitHub Markdown pages and wowMD Pro, a paid local-first webapp for local Markdown reading, highlights, notes, and HTML export. Features may change as the product evolves.
termsPage.licenseBody: wowMD Pro may be sold as a one-time lifetime license or offered with a trial. A license is for your personal use unless a separate written agreement says otherwise. Do not share, resell, or abuse license keys.
termsPage.localBody: You are responsible for the Markdown files, notes, highlights, and exports you open or create with wowMD. The app is designed to process documents locally in your browser, but you should keep backups of important files and exported content.
termsPage.allowedBody: Do not use wowMD to break the law, infringe others' rights, attack or disrupt services, bypass technical limits, reverse engineer paid access controls, or interfere with other users.
termsPage.thirdPartyBody: wowMD may link to third-party services such as Chrome Web Store, GitHub, payment providers, feedback forms, or video hosts. Those services are governed by their own terms and policies.
termsPage.openSourceBody: The wowMD extension may be distributed with open source code or dependencies. Open source licenses continue to apply to those parts. These terms do not remove rights granted by an applicable open source license.
termsPage.disclaimerBody: wowMD is provided as is and as available. We do not promise that every Markdown file, export, browser, store listing, reader, or device will work perfectly or without interruption.
termsPage.liabilityBody: To the maximum extent permitted by law, wowMD and its maintainers are not liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or lost-profit damages arising from your use of the product.
termsPage.changesBody: We may update these terms when the product, licensing, payment flow, or legal requirements change. The updated terms will be posted on this page with a new update date.
termsPage.contactBody: For questions about these terms, contact the maintainer through the feedback form linked on this website.
termsPage.pricingBody: wowMD Pro may be offered as free early access, a trial, an early-bird purchase, a one-time lifetime license, promotional discounts, or other paid access options. Exact prices, discounts, taxes, currency, and payment terms are shown at checkout or on the relevant purchase page. Prices and promotions may change over time based on product stage, availability, user demand, or business needs. Free access, testing access, or promotional access does not guarantee that the product will remain free permanently.

landing.title: Long Markdown, finally readable.
landing.subtitle: Choose where you read: GitHub pages, or local Markdown files.

landing.proHighlightBody: Mark important passages without changing the source file.

extension.metaTitle: wowMD - Free Chrome extension for readable GitHub Markdown
extension.metaDescription: wowMD is a free Chrome extension that makes long GitHub Markdown pages easier to navigate, scan, and read.
extension.proTitle: Need local files, highlights, notes, or export?
extension.proBody: wowMD Pro adds a local Markdown workspace with annotations and clean HTML export. The free extension stays focused on GitHub reading.
pro.metaTitle: wowMD Pro - Local Markdown reader with highlights, notes, and export
pro.metaDescription: wowMD Pro is a local-first webapp for reading local Markdown files, adding highlights and notes, and exporting clean HTML.
pro.label: wowMD Pro
pro.title: Your local Markdown reading workspace.
pro.subtitle: Open local Markdown files in the browser, highlight important passages, keep notes, and export clean reading copies without uploading your documents.
pro.localTitle: Open the Markdown files already on your device.
pro.localBody: Drop in a `.md` or `.markdown` file and read it in a focused workspace with outline navigation, folding, readable code, and table scrolling.
pro.notesTitle: Keep the useful parts attached to the document.
pro.notesBody: Mark important passages, add short notes, and keep annotation data local. The source Markdown stays untouched unless a future write-back feature is added.
pro.mockNote: Important idea saved as a local note.
pro.exportTitle: Turn one Markdown file into clean reading copies.
pro.exportBody: Create complete offline HTML for sharing, archiving, or focused reading outside the app.
pro.htmlBody: Self-contained, structured, readable offline HTML without the app runtime.
pro.roadmapTitle: Future work stays separate from today's promise.
pro.roadmapBody: These ideas are planned or being explored, but current purchase decisions should be based on the features available in the app today.
pro.pricingTitle: Simple early access, clear checkout later.
pro.pricingBody: The webapp may start with free early access while pricing is finalized. The planned paid model is a low-cost one-time lifetime license, with early-bird and promotional discounts possible.
